/bin/bash -lc "git diff --no-index -- draft.md revised.md || true
printf '\\n---CHANGES---\\n'
sed -n '1,120p' changes.md
printf '\\n---CHECK---\\n'
rg -n -i 'here.s the thing|marks a pivotal moment|transformative|research suggests|robust|plays a crucial role|in conclusion|streamlined|underscores|harnessing|today.s|tomorrow.s|the clearest|the only way|undeniably|guaranteed|proven|most common|the best way' revised.md || true
printf '\\n---FILES---\\n'
wc -l draft.md revised.md changes.md"
